name: Fix Authentication Bug
description: Fix bug where refresh token reuse was still allowed in TokenService
prompt: Fix the bug in src/TokenService.js where refresh token reuse is still allowed. The current implementation stores issued refresh tokens in a Set but never removes the old one when rotating. Implement proper token rotation: when a refresh token is used, it should be removed from the valid tokens set and a new one issued.
acceptance: Old refresh token is invalidated after use
New refresh token is issued on successful refresh
Test passes: 'should not allow refresh token reuse'
